description: This file defines classes related to log state management with versioning metadata and ETag support for Orleans grain state persistence, including mechanisms for handling log entries, versioning, and write vector bits.

classes.name: LogStateWithMetaDataAndETag
classes.description: A class extending grain state with versioning metadata and ETag, supporting serialization and string representation.

classes.name: LogStateWithMetaData
classes.description: A class representing log state with versioning and write vector metadata, supporting log entries and bit manipulation for concurrency control.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the log state with metadata and ETag to a string representation.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Retrieves the bit value for a specific replica in the write vector.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Toggles the bit for a specific replica in the write vector and returns the new bit state.
